user.title: Set up Azure AI Tasks
user.description: Enter your Azure AI endpoint, API key, and model(s). At least one model must be configured. Both endpoint styles work: classic Azure OpenAI (a *.openai.azure.com resource) and Azure AI Foundry v1 (a *.services.ai.azure.com resource) - the right API is selected automatically.

data.endpoint: Azure AI Endpoint URL (openai.azure.com or services.ai.azure.com)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Azure AI Tasks
reconfigure.description: Update your Azure AI endpoint, API key, and model(s). At least one model must be configured. Both endpoint styles work: classic Azure OpenAI (a *.openai.azure.com resource) and Azure AI Foundry v1 (a *.services.ai.azure.com resource) - the right API is selected automatically.

migrate_downgrade.title: Azure AI Tasks cannot read its saved configuration
migrate_downgrade.description: The saved configuration for "{title}" was written by a newer version of Azure AI Tasks (version {entry_version}); this version understands up to version {supported_version}. This usually means Azure AI Tasks was downgraded. Update it back to the newer version, or remove and re-add the integration.

migrate_incomplete_config.title: Azure AI Tasks needs its endpoint and API key again

confirm.title: Retry the Azure AI Tasks update
confirm.description: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so it could not finish updating. Reconfigure it first (Settings > Devices & Services > Azure AI Tasks > Configure), then submit this to try again.

migrate_incomplete_config_restart.title: Azure AI Tasks needs its endpoint and API key again
migrate_incomplete_config_restart.description: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so Azure AI Tasks could not finish updating it. Reconfigure it (Settings > Devices & Services > Azure AI Tasks > Configure), then restart Home Assistant to finish the update.

migrate_downgrade.message: The saved configuration for "{title}" is version {entry_version}, but this version of Azure AI Tasks only understands up to version {supported_version}.

migrate_incomplete_config.message: "{title}" has no endpoint or API key saved, so it could not finish updating.

migrate_transient.message: Could not save the updated Azure AI Tasks configuration; this will be retried.
